official_measurement_examples.name: DLL guidance update
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England's developer district-level licensing guidance was updated 20 March 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Three risk zones
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England-led DLL uses red, amber and green risk zones; red zones are excluded from DLL while amber and green zones can use the scheme subject to the scheme process.

official_measurement_examples.name: IACPC role
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England can issue and countersign an impact assessment and conservation payment certificate where development is suitable for district-level licensing.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning and licensing sequence
official_measurement_examples.fact: Developer guidance says after obtaining planning permission the developer must apply for the district-level great crested newt licence before starting licensed activities.

official_measurement_examples.name: A14 determination aim
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current A14 guidance says Natural England will decide whether to issue a mitigation licence within 30 working days of receiving the application.

official_measurement_examples.name: CL33 site registration
official_measurement_examples.fact: The low-impact class licence can only be used by registered ecological consultants and requires eligible sites to be registered before work starts.

official_measurement_examples.name: Other species remain separate
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England states DLL for great crested newts does not remove duties to survey and assess other protected and priority species and habitats.

official_measurement_examples.name: Scheme geography caveat
official_measurement_examples.fact: The March 2026 update states district-level schemes operate only in specified areas and removed the previous LPA-led list because no LPA-led schemes were then in existence.

core_rules: district level licensing suitability is not planning permission
planning permission is not a great crested newt licence
IACPC is not a district level licence
countersigned IACPC is not planning permission
red risk zone is not automatic planning refusal
amber risk zone is not automatic planning permission
green risk zone is not proof no great crested newts exist
risk-zone map is modelled evidence not a site survey result
DLL availability is geography-specific and must not be assumed nationally
DLL scheme operator must be identified for the actual area
Natural England-led guidance must not be applied to third-party scheme terms without evidence
district level licence is distinct from A14 mitigation licence
A14 application is not A14 licence grant
30-working-day A14 decision aim is not approval guarantee
planning condition discharge is distinct from wildlife licence issue
wildlife licence issue is not planning condition discharge
Natural England licence is not building regulations approval
Natural England licence is not landowner consent
conservation payment is not planning permission
conservation payment is not licence grant until the licensing process completes
IACPC site boundary must match the planning-development evidence
IACPC suitability does not satisfy every planning policy test
favourable conservation status test is distinct from no-satisfactory-alternative test
IROPI test must not be assumed satisfied from DLL suitability alone
other protected species duties remain outside GCN DLL
GCN DLL does not clear priority habitats
survey exemption under DLL is route-specific and not evidence no newts are present
lack of survey under DLL is not NO_DATA for licensing impact
CL33 registered consultant status is not planning permission
CL33 site registration is not planning permission
CL33 low-impact eligibility must be evidenced and not guessed
CL08 survey licence is not mitigation licence
CL09 survey licence is not mitigation licence
survey licence holder status is not project permission
class-licence registration is not site approval
wildlife licence fee payment is not licence grant
licence modification request is not modification approval
licence renewal request is not renewal approval
phased development requires phase-specific licensing evidence
prior mitigation licence does not automatically cover later phases
planning approval does not guarantee Natural England will grant a licence
wildlife licence does not transfer ownership or access rights
risk-zone colour is not parcel Future Growth score
scheme compensation pond strategy is not parcel habitat quality score
source and scheme dates must be preserved
NO_DATA must remain NO_DATA rather than no protected-species constraint
no parcel wildlife-licence planning clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
research confidence is not parcel protected-species accuracy
